body: JayArr, 2026-10-07: "the scaffold ruling should be case by case basis meaning im prompted for certainty on whther its scaffolding or a source." This withdraws the 'outside = scaffolding' default in the original constraint 28 wording, and the default the mirror had written into the package (v0.1.0 → v0.1.1).
plain: Source or scaffolding is case by case. JayArr is prompted for certainty every time; there is no default.
